caption:
Is Zepbound the same as Mounjaro?

Zepbound and Mounjaro both contain tirzepatide, made by Eli Lilly. Mounjaro is approved for type 2 diabetes and Zepbound for chronic weight management. Did you know this? Yes or no.

More at pepsafe.info/p/tirzepatide.html
